Facts(?) about bail:

Bail is set at a hearing, and can be paid at any point. There is never a deadline for bail once it is set.
Once bail is paid, the person is now able to leave the confines of jail. This is why people can ask others for help, and do things like "put up the house" to help pay - which takes time. No bail, no freedom; pay bail, get out. Simple as that.

Bail is a "guarantee" that the person will show up for trial. The more heinous the crime - or the more of a flight risk the defendant is - the larger bail tends to be.

If the defendant "skips bail" then the court gets to keep the bail. That is the whole reason for the "guarantee" effect of bail.

When the trial is over - no matter the outcome - the bail is returned to the defendant.

Bail is NOT a fine, and is not a "collected" fee for the court. It is strictly a "guarantee" that the defendant has a reason to attend the trial - to get the fucking money back.
